scripts.build:ui: cd dash/ui && npm install && npm run build && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/index.html','../src/page.html')"
scripts.deploy:dash: npm run build:ui && wrangler deploy --config dash/wrangler.toml
scripts.build:demo: cd dash/ui && VITE_DEMO=1 npx vite build --outDir dist-demo
scripts.test:ingest: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --alias:cloudflare:workers=./tests/cf-workers-stub.mjs --outfile=.wrangler/bot-test.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/finance.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=.wrangler/finance-test.mjs --log-level=warning && node --no-warnings tests/ingest.test.mjs
scripts.test:batch: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --alias:cloudflare:workers=./tests/cf-workers-stub.mjs --outfile=.wrangler/bot-test.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/batch.ts --format=esm --outfile=.wrangler/batch-test.mjs --log-level=warning && node --no-warnings tests/batch.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:ingest && npm run test:batch && npm run test:dash
scripts.test:dash: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --alias:cloudflare:workers=./tests/cf-workers-stub.mjs --outfile=.wrangler/bot-test.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild dash/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --main-fields=module,main --loader:.html=text --outfile=.wrangler/dash-test.mjs --log-level=warning && node --no-warnings tests/dash.test.mjs
